title: How far a fast pion travels
caption: A pion with τ = 26 ns and γ = 10 has mean decay length L = γβcτ ≈ 78 m. After one L, 1/e (37%) of the pions are left; without time dilation, cτ would give only 7.800000000000001 m.
alt: A falling exponential curve, the fraction of pions surviving against distance, passing through 1 over e at 78 metres.
description: At x = 78 m the fraction left is 1/e = 0.368.
